name: Dealing With Fear
overview: Scripture teaches that fear is to be met with trust and obedience to God, who promises to strengthen, help, and uphold His people. Isaiah 41:10 encourages believers not to be dismayed because God is with them, while Psalms 46:1 reminds us that God is a present refuge and strength in times of trouble. By submitting to God and resisting the devil, as James 4:7 instructs, believers can overcome fear and experience the blessings of obedience described in Deuteronomy 28:1.
